speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that background. You mentioned enjoying sunbathing; could you describe the appearance of the rash on your left dorsal hand in detail, specifically noting any color changes, scaling, or borders?

text: My main symptom is The presence of a rough, scaly, sandpaper-like plaque on the left dorsal hand. I also have No tenderness, No pain.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Actinic Keratosis.

Based on your description of a rough, scaly, sandpaper-like plaque on the dorsal hand of a 65-year-old with significant sun exposure, this is highly consistent with Actinic Keratosis. Given your history of diabetes, I want to ensure there are no secondary complications; would you like me to order a dermatoscopic exam or biopsy to confirm the lesion type and rule out early skin cancer?
